name: CUBE
description: CUBE is a collaborative multi-agent block-pushing environment designed to evaluate embodied cooperation in multi-agent systems. It combines symbolic reasoning with embodied interaction, supporting reinforcement learning, LLM-based agents, and hybrid architectures, with scalable difficulty and cooperation demands.
typical_sota_score: No single established SOTA; task-success rates vary widely by scenario (reported ranges effectively span 0%–100% depending on task difficulty and agent setup)
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Supports both symbolic and embodied agent evaluation; open-sourced platform with scalable curriculum.
